died.name: Joseph Justus Scaliger
died.desc: French Calvinist religious leader and scholar
died.last_words: I begin to perceive and feel the joys of eternal life. I shall soon behold Him, who was sacrificed for men; I long for the blessed sight. All else is to me as dross: there is nothing that could make me wish to live one hour longer.

died.name: James Quin
died.last_words: I could wish this tragic scene were over, but I hope to go through it with becoming dignity.

died.name: Louis XVI
died.cause: speaking to his executioners prior to his execution by guillotine
died.last_words: Frenchmen, I die guiltless of the crimes imputed to me. Pray God my blood fall not on France!

died.name: John Heckewelder
died.desc: American missionary for the Moravian Church

died.name: Joseph Beaumont
died.cause: announcing the first lines of a hymn to his congregation. He then fell dead as they sang the second line
died.last_words: Thee while the first Archangel sings, He hides his face behind his wings.

died.name: Vladimir Lenin
died.cause: to his dog who brought him a dead bird

died.name: Francis Crowley
died.last_words: You sons of bitches. Give my love to Mother.

died.name: Lytton Strachey
died.last_words: If this is dying, then I don't think much of it.

born.name: Samuel Spencer
born.cause: The 59-year-old North Carolina lawyer and former colonel was sleeping on a porch in Anson County while wearing a red cap. Spencer's bobbling head drew the attention of a turkey, which viewed Spencer as another turkey and fatally wounded him with its talons.

born.name: Adolphe Monod
born.last_words: This oppression is altogether physical: God is not the less with me. I am waiting for Him in the faith of Jesus Christ and of the Holy Spirit.

born.name: Stonewall Jackson
born.desc: American and Confederate soldier and general of the American Civil War
born.cause: dying of pneumonia after being wounded by friendly fire
born.last_words: Order A.P. Hill to prepare for action! Pass the infantry to the front rapidly! Tell Major Hawks.... Let us cross over the river and rest under the shade of the trees.

born.name: Alferd Packer
born.cause: who had served 18 years in prison for killing and eating five of his traveling companions in 1874
born.last_words: I'm not guilty of the charge.

born.name: Egon Friedell
born.cause: before jumping out a window to avoid capture by Gestapo

born.name: Herbert C. Jones
born.desc: United States Navy officer and Medal of Honor recipient
born.cause: mortally wounded aboard USS California (BB-44) during the attack on Pearl Harbor
born.last_words: Leave me alone! I am done for. Get out of here before the magazines go off.
